'''CardMaker recreation''' of version PC-E1 of [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion]]: the PC website card-list text, shown there by 21 July 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html VBlock7Type, 2012-07-21], Internet Archive): “While present at a battleground, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. While armed with Anakin's Lightsaber, her forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-princessleialostscion-pre.gif]]) prints the same words, but it is its own version (PC-E2, uploaded 25 February 2013; [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 2)]]); the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-01-Princess_Leia_Lost_Scion.png]]) and the Master List print the original text. Made 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card. Not an official image.
== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/0a/VB7-01-Princess_Leia_Lost_Scion-PC-E1-cardmaker.png Internet Archive item].
